ceiling_statement: FROZEN GUARANTEE. The maximum any feasible H1-H8 system can achieve in self-falsification is a TWO-REGIME certified adequacy (v1 raised): (1) PROOF-CARRYING EXCLUSION OF INFINITE DEFECT CLASSES wherever a machine-checked functional-correctness or refinement proof covers a seat — the proof refutes the entire (infinite) class of semantics-altering defects relative to the committed spec on the verified perimeter, strictly exceeding any finite mutation class there; proof-carrying admission is a TOTAL DECIDABLE procedure over (code, proof) pairs — Rice bars DECIDING arbitrary semantic properties, it does not bar CHECKING a supplied proof; (2) for the unverified remainder, adversarial adequacy certified as 100 percent mutation-kill over a DECLARED, hash-committed, finite class M of mutation operators and counter-design generators, with the kill matrix an offline-recomputable release artifact (H8) — the FLOOR mechanism for the unproven region, not the global maximum; (3) every hypothesis, mutant, or counter-design outside both regimes — including any surviving mutant — is a typed UNKNOWN that fail-closed blocks release (H2/H3) and escalates to the accountable human authority as a certificate-carrying transition (H6). No system can certify refutation-completeness over the open class of all possible defects OUTSIDE its committed specs and committed finite classes — completeness claims are always relative to the committed spec/class registry.
derivation: Computability, applied honestly: Rice's theorem makes non-trivial semantic properties of arbitrary code undecidable — no total procedure DECIDES 'no superior counter-design exists' or 'no undetected defect exists'. But proof-CHECKING is decidable: a candidate arriving with a machine-checked proof is admitted by a total decidable check, and the proof refutes an infinite defect class relative to its spec — so the v1 ceiling (finite-class kill as the maximum) was strictly below the attainable maximum on any verified perimeter. Verification theory (Popper asymmetry): universal correctness claims are refutable, never verifiable — EXCEPT relative to a committed formal spec, where a correctness proof is exactly a refutation-completeness certificate for the spec'd class; outside specs, the strongest coherent artifact is a corroboration certificate relative to a committed enumerable falsifier class (hashed, else the certificate is itself unfalsifiable). Consistency: self-graded falsifiers without an externally recomputable kill matrix trust a declared root (H8 violation); continuing past a surviving mutant is silent degradation (H3 violation). The v1 closing phrase 'nothing feasible today exceeds it' is deleted — resource phrasing may not appear inside an ABSOLUTE label; the ceiling is stated as the two-regime structure itself.
ceiling_kind: ABSOLUTE (with the two-regime structure; completeness always relative to committed specs and committed classes)
lean_obligation: Given a committed spec Sigma, a verified perimeter V with machine-checked proof P : Correct(V, Sigma), a finite committed class M, falsifier suite F, and release relation Admit: prove (R1 proof-regime) checkProof(V, P) = true implies every semantics-altering-mutant m of V w.r.t. Sigma is refuted by P (infinite-class exclusion: forall m, apply m V not-equiv-Sigma V implies not Correct(apply m V, Sigma)) and checkProof is a total decidable function of (code, proof); (R2 kill-regime) Admit S K implies forall m in M, exists f in F with runs f (apply m S) = FAIL, and recompute K (M, F, S) = K; (R3 fail-closed) a surviving mutant in M, or any candidate outside both regimes, implies not Admit and verdict = UNKNOWN_escalated — no third outcome exists in the verdict type.
